subject.title: fix(openai): reject malformed Codex image base64

question: Does a maintainer accept rejecting previously permissively decoded malformed Codex image payloads after directly confirming the exact sibling Codex Base64 contract?
rationale: The patch is narrowly scoped and has focused proof, but repository policy makes the Codex dependency contract a mandatory reviewer-owned gate rather than a contributor-only assertion.

options.title: Confirm contract and merge
options.body: Inspect the exact Codex image decoder and approve the strict malformed-payload behavior if it matches the intended upstream contract.

options.title: Preserve permissive decoding
options.body: Decline the fail-closed behavior if compatibility with malformed upstream image payloads is preferred, then close or revise the PR accordingly.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract and merge
